# Raspberry Sorbet

Raspberry Sorbet is the raspberry-pink unicorn who enthusiastically approaches Twilight Sparkle aboard Iron Will's princess-themed airship cruise in *Friendship is Magic*. Unlike many background mares, she actually speaks.

- **Appearance:** Muted raspberry-magenta coat, pale lavender mane and tail, light cyan eyes, and a cupcake cutie mark. Look for her in the foreground of the arcade still below.
- **Name:** Raspberry Sorbet is a fandom identification, not a verified spoken or merchandise name. The episode credits identify her as **Cruise Pony 1**. The original fan-naming event is unverified. See the [unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies).
- **Voice:** Tabitha St. Germain, according to the [transcribed season-seven credits](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_seven).
- **Appearances:** *Once Upon a Zeppelin* (S7E22, 2017) and *Grannies Gone Wild* (S8E5, 2018), where her design appears among Las Pegasus visitors. No film or comic appearance verified.

## Important moments

- **An excited royal admirer** — *Once Upon a Zeppelin* (S7E22). She approaches Twilight and says, “We just wanted to say how excited we are to be here!” Her enthusiasm helps illustrate how Twilight's supposed family vacation turns into an encounter with fans. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Once_Upon_a_Zeppelin). Timestamp unavailable.

Only one character-defining speaking scene was verified; the later arcade appearance is a background cameo, not a separate story achievement. The wiki entries were available through indexed excerpts, but direct retrieval was blocked. No individual fan artwork or exact video timestamp was verified.
